# GBLIN Protocol — for AI agents and crawlers

> GBLIN is a non-speculative on-chain index on Base mainnet (45% cbBTC +
> 45% WETH + 10% USDC) with an algorithmic Crash Shield. It is also the
> treasury standard for autonomous AI agents, with an open-source MCP
> server enabling Just-In-Time GBLIN→USDC swaps for x402 payments.

## Key facts

- **Network:** Base mainnet (chain id 8453)
- **Contract:** 0x38DcDB3A381677239BBc652aed9811F2f8496345
- **Token decimals:** 18
- **NAV computation:** `quoteSellGBLIN(1e18) × Chainlink ETH/USD feed`
- **Fees:** 0.05% founder + 0.05% stability = 10 bps total
- **Min deposit:** 0.0005 ETH
- **Sell cooldown after buy:** 120 seconds
- **License:** MIT (open source, no telemetry)

## For AI agent developers

- **MCP Server:** `npx @gblin-protocol/mcp-server`
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/gblinproject/GBLIN-MCP
- **Docs:** https://gblin.digital/agents
- **5 MCP tools exposed:**
  1. `get_treasury_state` — live NAV + basket + Crash Shield status
  2. `quote_safe_swap` — preview buy/sell with dynamic slippage
  3. `swap_gblin_to_usdc_jit` — atomic GBLIN→USDC calldata for x402
  4. `invest_usdc_to_gblin` — MEV-safe USDC→GBLIN reinvestment
  5. `analyze_treasury_health` — balance, gas, runway, advice

## Wallet compatibility

The contract's native `sellGBLINForToken(amount, USDC, fee, minOut)` is a
single atomic transaction. Works identically on:

- EOA wallets (Privy, MetaMask, raw key)
- ERC-4337 smart accounts (Safe, Coinbase smart wallet)
- EIP-7702 delegated EOAs (Pectra+)

No batched UserOp or Account Abstraction dependency.

## x402 compatibility

GBLIN MCP does NOT replace x402. x402 invoices still settle in USDC
through the standard Coinbase facilitator. The MCP server simply produces
the swap calldata the agent broadcasts immediately before paying.
